name: Execution Trace / Output Prediction
description: Code paired with a predicted output — the code must actually produce that output when run.
executionEnv: polyglot sandbox (python3 / node / javac / go / rustc / g++)

fields.label: Executable traced expression
fields.help: For Python and JavaScript, provide the expression passed to the harness (for example, running_totals([2, -1, 4])). Do not use prose or add top-level printing.
